summary: Iteration 3 validated the new forward-proxy gateway, port switching, and bulk-scan features end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases in test_gateway_bulk.py PASS (test_gateway_status_running, gateway_https_and_http_through_active [both HTTPS CONNECT and plain HTTP through :8888 return the active exit_ip and status shows connections>=2 & bytes_down>0 & last_target set], gateway_via_http_pool_item [activate an http pool row -> curl through :8888 returns that IP], gateway_via_socks5_build [POST /proxy/build socks5 US -> activate -> curl through :8888 returns new exit_ip], settings_port_switch_and_errors [POST {gateway_port:8899} switches port and tunnel works on :8899, GET /settings reflects 8899; POST 8080 returns 400 with 'sudah dipakai' and status still :8899 running; POST 80 returns 400 range error; POST 8888 restores], bulk_scan_flow [POST /pool/scan-bulk US per_state=2 -> running:true total 45; duplicate POST returns 409; status.done increases; stop returns running:false]). Frontend (localhost:3000): usage-guide gateway-status-chip shows ':8888 live · N conn', guide-tab-gateway is default active, guide-code-gateway contains 'Port          : 8888' and 'curl -x http://…:8888'. ArchitectureFlow 'Proxy Server' node shows ':8888 · live'. Settings dialog opens via topbar-settings-btn, settings-port-input prefilled 8888; changing to 8899 fires toast 'Gateway pindah ke port 8899' and chip updates to :8899 within 6s; posting 8080 shows error toast containing 'dipakai' and chip stays :8899; restored to 8888 successfully. Bulk scan: clicking pool-bulk-btn ('Scan USA') starts the job, button flips to 'Stop', bulk-progress renders 'scan massal US · state x/45' with percent bar; clicking Stop removes progress and button reverts to 'Scan USA'.

ui_bugs.issue: Fallback text uses ':8080' before gateway status loads — since env default is 8888 and 8080 is known-occupied in this container, users may briefly see the wrong port. Change fallback to '8888' or hide until gateway is fetched.

React 'two children with the same key' warning still floods the console on every render because /api/history rows reuse the proxy id as key. Not blocking but pollutes console and can cause row de-dup.

action_items: (low) ProxyTools.jsx line 65: change `|| "8080"` fallback to `|| "8888"` (or gate render on `gateway`) to avoid showing the known-occupied port during initial poll window.
(low, carried from iteration_2) Fix UsageHistory duplicate-key warning — either key rows on `${it.id}-${it.used_at}` or assign a unique history_id server-side in /api/history.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py handle_gateway_client: on non-CONNECT requests the raw request-line/headers are forwarded as-is (host header may still be absolute-URI hostname) — for stricter HTTP compliance rewrite Host header; works fine for api.ipify but some picky origins will reject. Also the client-side reader is not read past headers into upstream (rest bytes after \r\n\r\n are dropped) — GET has no body so OK, but POST plain-HTTP through the gateway would silently drop the body. Recommend: `uw.write(rest)` after headers, or forward the body length.
server.py bulk_worker: no per-state timeout — a stuck FloppyData call could freeze `current` for a long time. Consider `asyncio.wait_for(run_scan(...), timeout=90)`.

server.py save_settings: recovery path `await start_gateway(prev_port)` after a failed rebind is fine, but the intermediate `start_gateway(body.gateway_port)` sets `GATEWAY['port']=body.gateway_port` even after failure — the subsequent restore fixes it, but `gateway_status()` briefly reports the failed port. Consider not mutating GATEWAY['port'] until bind succeeds.

SettingsDialog.jsx savePort disables the Ganti Port button when `String(status?.gateway_port) === port`; after a failed 8080 attempt, the input still holds '8080' so retrying with same value is possible, but if user re-opens dialog it shows the previous good port only — minor UX inconsistency.
ProxyTools.jsx: fallback port '8080' contradicts the actual GATEWAY_PORT_DEFAULT=8888 (fix noted above).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical flows pass; 1 cosmetic fallback port + carry-over duplicate-key warning)

seed_data_creation: Bulk scan started and stopped during tests — pool grew from ~581 to ~665 US rows. No cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gateway is only reachable inside the container — use `localhost:8888` (or the current gateway_port from GET /api/gateway/status). External REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only serves /api routes. Bulk scan running-state persists across backend hot-reloads via the in-memory BULK dict; always POST /api/pool/scan-bulk/stop before starting a fresh scan test or you'll get 409. Setting/API tests are safe to re-run — the endpoint idempotently restores 8888 at the end.
rca of the issue: ProxyTools shows :8080 for the ~1-2s window between mount and the first `/api/gateway/status` poll. Root cause: hard-coded fallback string in ProxyTools.jsx:65 `gateway?.port || "8080"` doesn't match the real env default GATEWAY_PORT=8888. UsageGuide/ArchitectureFlow don't have this issue because they render only when gateway prop is set or use dynamic defaults. Fix: replace fallback with '8888' or conditionally render when gateway is loaded.
